title: Advanced Markdown Viewer
description: Live updates for open Markdown previews when a file changes on disk.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Keep open Markdown previews live: a change made to the file outside JupyterLab is applied to the preview without a reload. Off, the preview keeps what it showed until the document is reloaded, and nothing else in this extension runs.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often an open preview checks its file for changes.

fadeDuration.title: Highlight duration (milliseconds)
fadeDuration.description: How long the highlight on changed text takes to fade away.

animation.title: Animate changes
animation.description: Play out an external change as typing: added text appears letter by letter and removed text is deleted from its end after a pause. Off shows a change at once.

animationSpeed.title: Animation speed (characters per second)
animationSpeed.description: How fast added text is typed in and removed text is deleted from its end in the rendered view. 0 shows a change at once.

highlight.title: Highlight changes
highlight.description: Show added text on a green background and removed text on a red one.

tabCue.title: Mark the document tab
tabCue.description: Put a dot on the tab of a document that received a change.
